purpose: Auditable inventory of African capitals and related seats, separating prior city-level research from this batch.
scope: 54 African UN member states with separate political, administrative, legislative, royal and associated former/transitional seats; separately labelled Western Sahara/SADR and Somaliland supplement. Overseas territorial and provincial capitals excluded.
scopeNotes: Principal roster contains 63 city seats across 54 states; disputed/de facto supplement has three cities.
Previously checked means an actual city-specific investigation or city-region geometry request; country-only evidence does not satisfy it.
Roles and chosen points are research locators, not official boundaries or a statement about political recognition.

scopeSources.purpose: African Union member-state roster; current capital changes separately checked.
January 2026 Ciudad de la Paz designation and transition from Malabo
Egypt government headquarters in New Capital, May 2026
Official Burundi political capital Gitega and economic capital Bujumbura.
Reported provisional SADR seat, retained in the separately labelled supplement, not the national-capital count.
